name: Feature request

title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What can you not do today? Describe the real-world situation (e.g. "my NAS
runs ZFS and I cannot recover a deleted dataset", "the phone image has
TRIM'd blocks and I need..."). Context matters more than the feature name.

## Proposed solution

What should the tool do, and how should it behave in the interface and on
the command line?

## Alternatives you considered

Manual workarounds, other tools, existing techniques.

## Impact

- [ ] It affects recovery **fidelity** (files come out more complete)
- [ ] It affects **coverage** (more filesystems / formats / scenarios)
- [ ] It affects **safety** (less risk of overwriting the source)
- [ ] It affects **usability** (interface or CLI)

## Notes for implementers

Links to specifications (filesystem docs, format specs), existing code
locations, or fixtures you can provide.
